correctness.rationale: The unique flag U=joint image subset K=common kernel forces factorization through W=V/K to U. The vertical map W->U^k is injective exactly when K is the full kernel. A separate full matrix enumerator independently matches four complete small (n,k,q) histograms, and exact arithmetic checks transpose symmetry. No finite computation is treated as a proof for all n,k,q.

originality.rationale: The exact all-arity finite-field joint radical/socle distribution is not stated by the inspected component-geometry papers or the broad pair-annihilation enumeration. This is an arithmetic rather than geometric classification advance; standard Hall-polynomial reformulations remain a residual risk.
residual_risks: Proposition 3.5 of Kinser–Lőrincz gives a geometric parabolic-bundle description of one-rank strata. Its finite-field specialization plus an additional rank and Möbius count could be judged an immediate corollary even though no explicit joint count is stated. An implicit Hall-polynomial or preexisting finite-field point count may be equivalent.
2014 and 2018 geometry yields the underlying flags, so the added arithmetic may be considered a natural point-count consequence rather than a deeper structural theorem.
Fulman and Guralnick 2021 full text was inspected; it covers pair totals rather than arbitrary-arity two-rank square-zero counts.
Semantic literature-index coverage is not exhaustive and cannot certify global novelty.

value.rationale: Radical and socle dimensions are canonical simultaneous module invariants fundamental to representation varieties. The closed all-dimensional, all-finite-field, all-arity joint count is a complete labeled two-invariant census, not an arbitrary slice or a mere restatement of component counts; even the 3-dimensional binary two-loop case has genuinely different joint strata. It is a finite-field arithmetic refinement motivated by existing geometry, not a claim to new indecomposable or singularity theory.
